gen-gf-grandstander-gf-biryani: Biryani leaves every small counter unclogged, each e showing a generous eye. Grandstander is best at bold, expressive display letters, while the plain sans Biryani is best at constant-width lines that never clog.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-carrois-gothic: Expressive, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, Grandstander draws its lines like a taut string. And Carrois Gothic, a modern plain sans, sits lower, with a generous opening in every c.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Expressive and loud, Grandstander has no thick-thin shift, its lines like a steel cable outline. Carrois Gothic SC, a contemporary sans, sits lower and keeps a clear opening at the end of every curve.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-duru-sans: Grandstander: thin steel rod bent into bold, expressive letters. Over many lines of text, Duru Sans lets wide openings on small letters carry the rhythm while ascenders hardly show.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-georama: Approachable on the body side, Georama has a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, and Grandstander shouts above it. Round letters whose rims match the stems tie the two together.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-gidole: Grandstander is all constant-width lines and tall x-height swagger. Gidole, the plain sans here, with terminals parted like open scissor blades, draws every stroke with neon-tube consistency, echoing that constant width.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-golos-text: Big-voiced and tall in the body, Grandstander sets the mood. The heading is best when shouting, whereas the sans Golos Text is best filling the line with one-width strokes and a widely parted s.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray of constant line weight. Grandstander is best at bold, expressive display, while the plain sans below, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle, is best at steady hum.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-vadodara: Grandstander hits hard: bold, expressive, short ascenders, tall x-height. Hind Vadodara, a professional sans, holds a thickness that never changes with direction and leaves spacious gaps in its rounds, echoing the heading's constant-width lines.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-huninn: Constant-width lines make Grandstander loud and expressive, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. And Huninn, the modern sans-serif below, matches that sturdiness with crossbars as fat as its stems.
